title: Ordinary supported coefficient tensor square from quotient normalization
statement: For any commutative ring A, old and new product supports, and scheme map h between their product schemes, let a0,a1,a2 be coefficient maps for the product, first factor and second factor. If each map carries its constant quotient to the inverse image of the corresponding old quotient via the canonical constant comparison, then a0 followed by inverse image of the old coefficient tensor comparison and its tensor comparison equals the new coefficient tensor comparison followed by a1 tensor a2. The statement uses the coefficient constructions of [def-pur-supported-exterior-product].

source.place: Tag 0F1E; ordinary coefficient normalization and signed totalization in step 11 of lem-pur-supported-product-localization.

proof.text: The product quotient is epic by the normalized supported coefficient adjunction: equality after the quotient implies equality of adjoints after the monic kernel inclusion.

Cancel that quotient. The three normalization hypotheses and the defining normalization of the coefficient tensor comparison reduce the square to the tensor square for inverse image of constants. The constant pullback comparison is monoidal by conjugation of the monoidal sections map. Its tensor identity and tensor-comparison naturality complete the proof.

theorem supportedCoefficientTensor_quotientSquare
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {S X Y B D S' X' Y' B' D' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : Y ⟶ S) (b : B ⟶ X) (d : D ⟶ Y)
    (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g' : Y' ⟶ S') (b' : B' ⟶ X') (d' : D' ⟶ Y')
    [IsClosedImmersion b] [IsClosedImmersion d]
    [IsClosedImmersion b'] [IsClosedImmersion d']
    (h : pullback f' g' ⟶ pullback f g) (M N : ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
    (a₀ : (supportedCoefficients A (supportedProductImmersion f' g' b' d')).obj (M ⊗ N) ⟶
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).obj
        ((supportedCoefficients A (supportedProductImmersion f g b d)).obj (M ⊗ N)))
    (a₁ : (supportedFirstCoefficients A f' g' b').obj M ⟶
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).obj ((supportedFirstCoefficients A f g b).obj M))
    (a₂ : (supportedSecondCoefficients A f' g' d').obj N ⟶
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).obj ((supportedSecondCoefficients A f g d).obj N))
    (h₀ : supportedCoefficientQuotient A (supportedProductImmersion f' g' b' d') (M ⊗ N) ≫
        a₀ = (Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).inv.app (M ⊗ N) ≫
          (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).map
            (supportedCoefficientQuotient A (supportedProductImmersion f g b d) (M ⊗ N)))
    (h₁ : supportFirstOrdinaryCoefficientQuotient A f' g' b' M ≫ a₁ =
      (Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).inv.app M ≫
        (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).map
          (supportFirstOrdinaryCoefficientQuotient A f g b M))
    (h₂ : supportSecondOrdinaryCoefficientQuotient A f' g' d' N ≫ a₂ =
      (Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).inv.app N ≫
        (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).map
          (supportSecondOrdinaryCoefficientQuotient A f g d N)) :
    a₀ ≫ (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).map
        (supportedCoefficientTensor A f g b d M N) ≫
      Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h)
        ((supportedFirstCoefficients A f g b).obj M)
        ((supportedSecondCoefficients A f g d).obj N) =
      supportedCoefficientTensor A f' g' b' d' M N ≫ (a₁ ⊗ₘ a₂)
